summary: German-language visa and expat service in Pattaya handling DTV, retirement, LTR and Thailand Privilege visas, extensions of stay, Thai bank accounts, driving licences, Schengen visas, marriage paperwork and tax filing.

facts.label: Language
facts.value: Service in German for German-speaking expats and visitors
facts.quote: Wir sind DER unabhängige Dienstleister für deutschsprachige Auswanderer und Urlauber in Pattaya und Umgebung.

facts.label: Visa types
facts.value: DTV, retirement, Schengen, Thailand Privilege, LTR and overstay cases
